name: Holistic Healing

phase_0.boundary_condition: the closed field of the whole-person aura

VINIT.justification: the pure potential and innate wholeness before any imbalance or healing intervention occurs

TANCH.justification: the closed boundary of the therapeutic field that safely holds the space for deep systemic healing

AFWD.justification: the directed flow of energy, attention, and life force moving toward the site of dis-ease

AREV.justification: the descent into and dissolution of trapped trauma, emotional blockages, and physical tension

CLINK.justification: the sequential integration of multiple healing modalities such as bodywork, breathwork, and meditation

IMSCRIB.justification: the body's self-recognition of its own wholeness and inherent capacity to heal itself

FSPLIT.justification: the splitting of the vital force into sympathetic mobilization (yang) and parasympathetic restoration (yin)

FFUSE.justification: the reconstitution of the sympathetic and parasympathetic branches back into the unified, regulated vital force

EVALT.justification: the affirmative state of safety, coherence, and cellular alignment where healing is actualized

EVALF.justification: the negative state of encountering blockages, pain, or autonomic dysregulation during the healing process

ENGAGR.justification: the paradice of simultaneously holding profound dissolution and profound regeneration without immediate resolution

IFIX.justification: the permanent epigenetic, cellular, and energetic fixation of the new state of wholeness

phase_3.void_description: unmanifested potential, the unformed vital force before any imbalance or healing occurs
phase_3.true_description: coherence, the state of autonomic and systemic balance where healing is actualized and integrated
phase_3.false_description: dissonance, the state of blockage, trauma holding, or autonomic dysregulation
phase_3.both_description: the healing crisis, a paradice where profound pain and profound relief are simultaneously held as the system reorganizes

steps.domain_action: Genesis of the vital force, the unmanifested potential of the whole person.
Establishment of the holistic container, the closed boundary of the therapeutic field.
The forward flow of healing intention toward the site of dis-ease.
Bifurcation of the vital force into sympathetic activation and parasympathetic restoration.
Affirmation of the parasympathetic pathway, achieving safety and resonance.
Deepening of cellular repair and somatic settling along the T-arm.
Confrontation of the sympathetic pathway, encountering trauma and resistance.
Descent into and release of trapped emotional and physical blockages along the F-arm.
Reintegration of both autonomic pathways into the unified vital force.
Sequential chaining of physical, emotional, and spiritual alignment modalities.
The healing crisis, holding the paradice of simultaneous pain and relief.
The innate intelligence recognizing its own wholeness, the system knowing itself.
Permanent fixation of the new baseline, the cellular and epigenetic memory update.
Final sealing of the holistic field, closing the boundary around the integrated state.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the practitioner's intuition and diagnostic framework
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the fascial network and neuroendocrine signaling
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the circadian rhythm and autonomic nervous system
phase_5.alfs_store: the universal morphic field of wholeness

phase_6.cycle_cost: metabolic and emotional energy expended during the healing crisis
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: a state of systemic dissonance and fragmented vital force
phase_6.post_cycle_state: a state of integrated coherence and unified vital force
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the energy expended in release is exactly balanced by the energy restored through coherence, conserving the total vital force.
